labels.name: Stratum corneum
labels.function: 10-30 rows of dead anucleate cells; acidic main barrier

labels.name: Stratum lucidum
labels.function: 3-5 rows of dead cells with eleiden; thick skin only

labels.name: Stratum granulosum
labels.function: Keratohyalin-rich cells; secretes lamellar bodies for water barrier

labels.name: Stratum spinosum
labels.function: Large-nucleus cells with prickles around tonofibrils at desmosomes

labels.name: Stratum basale
labels.function: Single row of dividing stem cells; hemidesmosome anchor

labels.name: Papillary dermis
labels.function: Loose connective tissue with capillaries and touch corpuscles

labels.name: Melanocyte
labels.function: Neural crest-derived; passes melanosomes to keratinocytes

labels.name: Merkel cell
labels.function: With an afferent ending, a slowly adapting fine-touch unit

labels.name: Langerhans cell
labels.function: Birbeck granules, CD207; primary antigen-presenting cell

labels.name: Epidermis
labels.function: Keratinized epithelium of ectodermal origin, the outer layer

labels.name: Papillary dermis
labels.function: Loose connective tissue projecting up into the epidermis

labels.name: Reticular dermis
labels.function: Thick dense irregular connective tissue; strength, elasticity

labels.name: Hypodermis
labels.function: Loose connective tissue with adipocytes; binds skin loosely

labels.name: Hair shaft
labels.function: Keratinized strand projecting from the follicle above the surface

labels.name: Sebaceous gland
labels.function: Acinar gland; holocrine release of oily, waxy lubricant

labels.name: Arrector pili muscle
labels.function: Smooth muscle whose contraction causes goosebumps

labels.name: Apocrine sweat gland
labels.function: Decapitation secretion of oily, pheromone sweat; active at puberty

labels.name: Eccrine sweat gland
labels.function: Merocrine watery sweat for thermoregulation; opens at a pore

labels.name: Meissner corpuscle
labels.function: Fast adapting; light touch and low-frequency vibration

labels.name: Ruffini ending
labels.function: Slowly adapting; skin stretch and sustained pressure

labels.name: Pacinian corpuscle
labels.function: Fast adapting; deep pressure and high-frequency vibration
